restrictions.description: The restrictions on traffic, such as single lane closed or speed limit 50 km/h

road_name.description: The road's name, such as Kehä III, where it has one

road_number.description: The road it is on; empty for an area-wide message

severity.description: For roadworks: how much they affect traffic, such as high

situation_id.description: The message's id, which 'Get a road traffic message' takes

start_time.description: When it starts, ISO 8601 in UTC

title.description: The headline, in Finnish as Fintraffic publishes it

updated_at.description: When it was last updated, ISO 8601 in UTC

version.description: Its version, which rises with each update

work_types.description: For roadworks: the kinds of work, such as resurfacing

municipality.description: The place the list was narrowed to; empty when not

road_number.description: The road the list was narrowed to; empty when not

total_count.description: How many of this kind are current in all of Finland

description: Use Finland's live traffic data in a workflow. Digitraffic is Fintraffic's open data service for rail, road and sea. Get a station's next departures with delays and their causes, find trains between two stations, follow a train, see its carriages and where it is now, and read station announcements. Read road traffic messages and roadworks, road weather stations, weather camera pictures, traffic volumes and road condition forecasts. Find ships near a place, look one up, list a port's arrivals and departures, and check faults in buoys and lights. Triggers fire on a new road traffic message and on a train running late at a station. No account or API key required.

digitraffic_new_traffic_message_trigger.description: Triggers when Fintraffic publishes a new road traffic announcement, roadworks, weight restriction or exempted transport, optionally only on one road or in one municipality

parameters.description: Traffic announcements (accidents, closures, poor driving conditions), roadworks, weight restrictions or exempted transports. Leave it empty for traffic announcements.
parameters.name: message_type

parameters.description: Only messages about this road, such as 4. Leave it empty for every road.
parameters.name: road_number

parameters.description: Only messages in this municipality or area, such as Tampere. Leave it empty for all of Finland.
parameters.name: municipality

digitraffic_train_delayed_trigger.description: Triggers when a passenger train's departure from a station, or its arrival where it ends, is running late by at least the minutes you choose, once per train and day

parameters.description: The railway station to watch.
parameters.name: station

parameters.description: How late a train must be before it fires, in whole minutes. Leave it empty for 5.
parameters.name: minimum_delay
